title: The Choir of Marrow Creek
author: Oscar Ravensworth
blurb: August Underhill, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
